configuration_files.title: Configuration files
configuration_files.description:
* The file /sites/default/settings.php/ is not protected from modifications
   and poses a security risk. You must change the file's permissions to be
   non-writable.

   modifications and poses a security risk. You must change the file's
   permissions to be non-writable.

node_access.title: Node Access Permissions
node_access.description:
If the site is experiencing problems with permissions to content, you may  
have to rebuild the permissions cache. Rebuilding will remove all privileges  
to content and replace them with permissions based on the current modules and  
settings. Rebuilding may take some time if there is a lot of content or  
complex permission settings. After rebuilding has completed, content will  
automatically use the new permissions. Rebuild permissions [1]

[1] https://buriton11.ddev.site/admin/reports/status/rebuild

webform_libraries.title: Webform: External libraries
webform_libraries.description:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*Choices 11.0.2* (Installed)
    The Choices [1] library is installed in */libraries/choices*./(Choices.js
    is used to improve the user experience for select menus. Choices.js is an
    alternative to Select2.}/
*Code Mirror 5.65.12* (Installed)
    The Code Mirror [2] library is installed in
    */libraries/codemirror*./(Code Mirror is used to provide a text editor
    for YAML, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript configuration settings and
    messages.}/
*jQuery: Input Mask 5.0.9* (Installed)
    The jQuery: Input Mask [3] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.inputmask*./(Input masks are used to ensure predefined
    and custom formats for text fields.}/
*jQuery: International Telephone Input 17.0.19* (Installed)
    The jQuery: International Telephone Input [4] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.intl-tel-input*./(International Telephone Input is
    used by the Telephone element.}/
*jQuery: RateIt 1.1.5* (Installed)
    The jQuery: RateIt [5] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.rateit*./(RateIt is used to provide a customizable
    rating element.}/
*jQuery: Select2 4.0.13* (Installed)
    The jQuery: Select2 [6] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.select2*./(Select2 is used to improve the user
    experience for select menus. Select2 is the recommended select menu
    enhancement library.}/
*jQuery: Text Counter 0.9.1* (Installed)
    The jQuery: Text Counter [7] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.textcounter*./(Word or character counting, with
    server-side validation, is available for text fields and text areas.}/
*jQuery: Timepicker 1.14.0* (Installed)
    The jQuery: Timepicker [8] library is installed in
    */libraries/jquery.timepicker*./(Timepicker is used to provide a polyfill
    for HTML 5 time elements.}/
*Popper.js 2.11.6* (Installed)
    The Popper.js [9] library is installed in
    */libraries/popperjs*./(Popper.js is used to provide tooltip behavior for
    elements.}/
*Progress Tracker 2.0.7* (Installed)
    The Progress Tracker [10] library is installed in
    */libraries/progress-tracker*./(Progress Tracker is used by multi-step
    wizard forms.}/
*Signature Pad 2.3.0* (Installed)
    The Signature Pad [11] library is installed in
    */libraries/signature_pad*./(Signature Pad is used to provide a signature
    element.}/
*Tabby 12.0.3* (Installed)
    The Tabby [12] library is installed in */libraries/tabby*./(Tabby is used
    to display tabs in the administrative UI}/
*Tippy.js 6.3.7* (Installed)
    The Tippy.js [13] library is installed in */libraries/tippyjs*./(Tippy.js
    is used to provide tooltip behavior for elements.}/


[1] https://choices-js.github.io/Choices/
[2] https://codemirror.net/
[3] https://robinherbots.github.io/Inputmask/
[4] https://github.com/jackocnr/intl-tel-input
[5] https://github.com/gjunge/rateit.js
[6] https://select2.github.io/
[7] https://github.com/ractoon/jQuery-Text-Counter
[8] https://github.com/jonthornton/jquery-timepicker
[9] https://github.com/floating-ui/floating-ui
[10] https://nigelotoole.github.io/progress-tracker/
[11] https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad
[12] https://github.com/cferdinandi/tabby
[13] https://github.com/atomiks/tippyjs

webform_spam.title: Webform: Spam protection
webform_spam.description:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*CAPTCHA [1]*
    Provides CAPTCHA for adding challenges to arbitrary forms.
*reCAPTCHA [2]*
    Uses the Google reCAPTCHA [3] web service to improve the CAPTCHA system.
*Honeypot [4]*
    Mitigates spam form submissions using the honeypot method.


[1] https://www.drupal.org/project/captcha
[2] https://www.drupal.org/project/recaptcha
[3] https://cloud.google.com/security/products/recaptcha
[4] https://www.drupal.org/project/honeypot
